record.question: An important goal of renal diet planning is to:
options: Reduce kidney workload and prevent complications
record.explanation: Answer B: Reduce kidney workload and prevent complications. CKD nutrition planning aims to meet nutritional needs while managing sodium, potassium, phosphorus, fluid and protein according to the individual, to reduce complications and avoid malnutrition. Reference: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/kidney-disease/chronic-kidney-disease-ckd/healthy-eating-adults-chronic-kidney-disease. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
